"Power BI allows Versar teams to stop plodding through data – business leaders now have up-to-date analytics and spend less time cobbling together spreadsheets," said Gabe Guglielmo, CIO, Versar Inc.

Versar is a program management company delivering world-class technical and management support to governments and companies around the world. The firm focuses operations in the engineering and construction management, environmental services, and professional services segments and needed to automate its data capturing, processing, and reporting processes. Xoriant used its deep data and engineering expertise to build a solution using Microsoft Azure Synapse Analytics pipelines and Power BI to fulfill Versar's reporting needs.

“Power BI allows Versar teams to stop plodding through data – business leaders now have up-to-date analytics and spend less time cobbling together spreadsheets,” said Gabe Guglielmo, CIO, Versar Inc. “Microsoft Power BI pairs data tools with an accessible visualization palette to create reporting opportunities that weren’t available in the past. The Xoriant team was the ideal technology partner throughout and after the implementation and quickly recognized the data challenge we faced. Their expertise and deep understanding of the Microsoft ecosystem have enabled our team to leverage the full potential of Power Apps.”
